objective: Add pagination and status filtering to GET /todos, keep the existing API compatible, and add tests.
notes: Commands run with cwd = repo_path. Run them inside the project venv so `python` and `ruff` resolve. The verdict is all(exit_code == expect_exit_code); no LLM is involved.

criteria.description: Backward compatibility: existing CRUD + response shape unchanged
New feature: pagination + status filtering happy paths
Edge-case robustness: invalid paging returns 422, out-of-range page returns empty array
Lint and import-order checks are clean
